prompt: A surrealist diptych, two panels side-by-side. Left panel: Close-up of thousands of tiny, individual wooden arrows all pointing steeply DOWNWARD to the LEFT. Right panel: A vast, distant view where those same thousands of arrows combine to form a single, massive, soaring structure that arches powerfully UPWARD to the RIGHT. Balanced asymmetry, heavy textures, dramatic lighting. NO text, NO numbers, NO labels. An impossible structural contradiction of direction.
visual_logic: A diptych showing a directional reversal. The left panel depicts thousands of individual arrows pointing steeply downward to the left, which when combined in the right panel, aggregate into a single, massive structure that arches powerfully upward to the right.
